title: Nat Cole gradually giving up piano
summary: When Lee joined, Nat sat and played piano and sang in small clubs, then stood once they played bigger rooms like the Copacabana and Chez Paree.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: During the time you were with Nat, you were there during the time that he gradually gave up much piano playing, right? When you first joined him, he was still doing piano, right?
When I first joined him, he was sitting down playing piano, and he was singing ...
And sometimes he even played without singing, didn't he?
Yea. You mean when I first joined him?

Oh yeah, because he was getting used to standing up. When we started playing the larger clubs, like the La Vie en Rose, he would still sit and play, you know, in small clubs like that -- but once we got in to the Copa-Cabana, and --see, the next thing, we came to Chicago, we played the Chez Paree.
